title: WorkspaceSnapshotRestoreRequest
x-cloud-agents-semantic-constraints: The server resolves the source Target, physical snapshot, digest, image, resources and credentials
docker-volume-v1 requires a published RuntimeProfile fixed to the snapshot source Target; portable-tar-v1 accepts any compatible ready Docker Target
Cross-Target restore revalidates the stopped source and fences all future writers for its source Workspace before accepting the destination
Restore creates a new Workspace volume and Sandbox and never overwrites an existing destination
